_note: The people around the athlete (GDD 4.9.5, session P1; Cast + StoryletSystem). Made once per career from the career's own dice (the athlete's name and birth date: same career = same people; the global dice are never touched) when StoryletSystem.people_enabled is on (only main.gd switches it on: the tools never get the cast). Everyone is fictional. family: one or two parents (two_parents = the share of careers with two at home) with the ATTITUDE of the creation answer 'What is your family's sporting background?' (attitudes.<id>.from lists the answers; '' = an older save: `default`); with the answer 'An older sibling runs' an older sibling who runs. friends: a best friend from school who is not an athlete + `others` more, each with a trait; with a previous sport (the creation answer) one of the others is from the old team. partners: the close training partners picked from the coach's training group (C1), by `prefer` (role order); the rest of the group stays listed and can still write as 'teammate'. school: the staff of the athlete's school stage (comprehensive = grades 8-9; secondary = after grade 9, by name only until P2). rivals: a rival met `met_min` times in races becomes a person in the Rivals thread, at most `max` (the ones met most first); `note_chance` = how often one of them writes on the evening after a race you both ran. relation_start = each role's relationship 0-100 at the start; relation_words = the word shown for a relationship (upper limits). life = the yearly calendar the moments' `days_to` / `days_after` conditions read (fixed dates, juhannus = the Friday between 19 and 25 June, easter, the school year's first and last day from SchoolCalendar, the athlete's birthday, a meet of competitions.json by id, the confirmation camp from the choice). mood_scale: a reply's confidence / motivation / stress points from anyone but the coach are multiplied by this before MindSystem.from_moment (measured in storylet_check part 7: with 1.0 the moments pushed motivation to Keen in 71 % of weeks against M1's ~17 %, training quality up ~1 %; the coach's words keep their M1 weight). sleep: a reply's `sleep` points (negative = a late night) become life load on the NEXT day (`life_load_per_point`, data/school_life.json texts.pulls.late_night); grades: a reply's `grades` points move every academic subject's level by `grades_per_point` (school drifts it back over the weeks).

family.athlete_word: Parent, ran at a good level

athletics.word: Knows the sport · expects a lot
athletics.text: One of your parents ran at a good level. They know what a 400 m split means and they notice everything.

top.text: A parent was a top athlete in another sport. Discipline is a family value, and so are results.

supportive.text: Your family is behind you. They drive you to meets and ask how it went.

sporty.text: A sporty family at a relaxed level: they like that you train, as long as you enjoy it.

puzzled.text: Your family is kind about it, but sport is a foreign language to them.

against.text: Your family thinks sport is a waste of time. Results and good grades might change their minds, slowly.

coming_round.text: Your family has started to take your running seriously. They still ask about your grades first.

warmth._note: Session L3a: a family that is against the sport counts good signs (counter family_warmth) from what happens, not from replies: a PB, a report card with an academic average of at least card_avg. At 3 it comes round (fam_against_softens, a feed message that changes the attitude).

away._note: Session L3a: weeks away that take the free-time slots when they come (StoryletSystem.away_on). The confirmation camp of the flag chosen in February (the story beat fam_rippi_choice): `days` days from its start (Cast.occurrence), the slots `activity` with the chip `chip`. The day confirmation school (rippi_day) takes no slots.

life._note: Events of the year for the moments' conditions days_to / days_after {event: [min, max]} (0 = today). kind fixed = month + day every year; juhannus = midsummer eve (the Friday between 19 and 25 June); easter = Easter Sunday; school_start / school_end = the first / last school day of the school year (SchoolCalendar, the athlete's town); birthday = the athlete's; meet = a meet of competitions.json by id (the nearest year it is held); rippileiri = the confirmation camp week the player chose (camps: the Monday it starts, `nth` Monday of `month` in the year the athlete turns 15; the flag of the choice names it).
